question: The first battle for independence against the British in India was fought in the year _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1857**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **First Battle of Independence**

 
 
• The first fight for **independence**, which occurred in **1857**, is thought to be one of the turning points in the struggle for Indian **independence**.
 
• The reason for the Revolt of 1857 is the immediate factor was the introduction of the 'Enfield' rifle.
 
• The cartridge had to be bitten off before loading it into the gun.
 
• Indian sepoys believed that the cartridge was greased with either pig fat or made from cow fat.
 
• 1857 revolt started firstly on 29th March 1857 from Barrackpur (West Bengal) by Mangal Pandey. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Causes of the revolt:

 
• Economic Causes

 
 
• ​Economic exploitation of the country by the British.
 
• Heavy taxation.
 
 
 
• Socio-Political Causes
 
 
• Subsidiary Alliance – Lord Wellesley
 
• The doctrine of Lapse – Lord Dalhousie
 
 
 
• Religious Causes
 
 
• Taxation of mosque and temple lands.
 
• Activities of Christian missionaries.
 
 
 
• Immediate Causes
 
 
• General Service Enlistment Act.
 
• Inferior emoluments compared to his British counterpart.
 
• News of mixing of bone dust in wheat flours.
 
• The cartridge of the Enfield rifle was made of beef and pork fat.
